address: GF, Shangri-La The Fort Hotel, 30th Street corner 5th Avenue, Bonifacio Global City, Taguig - Metro Manila, 1634, The Philippines
bio: Hidden beneath Shangri-La The Fort, this retro-inspired spot opens with a moody corridor and staircase leading to a vibrant 1970s-style space. The mezzanine in the Living Room is the place to be. Start with a cocktail before diving into a Japanese-Brazilian menu packed with truffle, Wagyu and scallops. If you're feeling indecisive, opt for the chef's tasting menu. The weekday lunch is good value; weekends shift into party mode with a live DJ from 11pm.
